description: Audit a mortgage servicer's escrow accounting statement from the borrower's side, line by line: recompute the aggregate-accounting trial running balance month by month from the stated opening balance, monthly escrow deposits, and disbursements; diff the servicer's stated end-of-month balances against the recomputation, flagging each discrepant line; check the stated cushion against the one-sixth cap; and classify the account as balanced, shortage, surplus, or deficiency (732), then a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). This checks the borrower-side statement, distinct from the servicer-side servicing-audit chain. Numeric values only, never identifiers; a divergence is an arithmetic finding, never a legal determination. Not legal advice.
name: escrow-statement-check

steps.handoff: Recomputes the aggregate-accounting trial running balance month by month from the stated opening balance, monthly escrow deposits, and disbursements; the servicer's stated end-of-month balances are diffed line by line against the recomputation with each discrepant line flagged, the stated cushion is checked against the one-sixth cap, and the account is classified as balanced, shortage, surplus, or deficiency
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run's execution_hashes (final stage)

title: Escrow Statement Check
